mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market overheating condition, defined by unemployment rate exceeding 4.5%, signals tight labor conditions that may lead to inflationary pressures and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS have increased by at least 0.5% MoM, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation, measured by CPIAUCSL exceeding 205, signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 205, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in industrial production, indicated by INDPRO rising above 115, signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO exceeds 115, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market boom, defined by housing starts exceeding 1500 thousand units, signals strong consumer confidence and increased construction activity, which boosts economic growth expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST exceeds 1500, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime, characterized by unemployment rate below 4.0% and payroll growth exceeding 0.5% month-over-month, strong labor conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the tight labor market condition, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 205) and a stagnant federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS change < 0.1% in the prior month) signals inadequate monetary policy response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the high inflation and stagnant policy condition, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.
